policy: Every exception in pnpm-workspace.yaml to the release-age gate, the trust gate or normal resolution is listed here: one exact version, the reason with its evidence, the date the evidence was checked, and the date it must be re-decided (at most 92 days later). tools/dependency-exceptions.test.ts, part of pnpm check, fails when this file and pnpm-workspace.yaml disagree and from the expiry date on, until the exception is re-verified or removed.

exceptions.reason: Floor for the same advisory (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q): every dependent asks for ^1.2.1, so without the override a fresh resolution may keep the vulnerable 1.2.1, which pnpm audit then fails. Remove once no dependent can resolve below 1.2.2.

Replaces the former trust-policy exclusion. semver 6.3.1 (the 6.x backport of the CVE-2022-25883 fix, published without provenance after 7.5.4 had it) fails trustPolicy no-downgrade, and @babel/core (through eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1.1, lint time only) asks for ^6.3.1. The override resolves that one range to semver 7.8.5, which passes the trust policy and the 14-day age gate; @babel/core uses only API that 6.x and 7.x share. Remove once @babel/core depends on a semver release that passes trust.
